_what: Flip-flops that synthesis legitimately removes (constant, or never read), per design, so check_signoff.py can require an exact register count. Format: "<design dir name>": {"removed_registers": <int>, "reason": "<why those bits are dead by design>"}. The check fails when surviving sequential cells < RTL registers - removed_registers. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can verify in the RTL. JSON has no comments, hence this field.
